findings.divergence: PV-3.C2 enumerates FOUR reserved transition_name values (BLOCKS_X_RESOLVED, BLOCKS_X_DEFERRED_WITH_OI, BLOCKS_X_FALSE_POSITIVE, TRIGGER_OVERRIDE) but ADR-0063 §Decision (L86, L100, L162) reserves only THREE. The TRIGGER_OVERRIDE name does not appear in ADR-0063, the state-transitions-log-entry-template.md, execute-orchestrator.md, parse_blocks_x_markers.py, or AT-021 prose ('the three closure values'). Producers correctly aligned to the ADR ground truth; the verdict honors ADR ground truth and surfaces the validator-side drift.
